description: Header file defining functions, classes, and constants for loading and handling mobile modules in PyTorch JIT, including functions for loading modules, extracting extra files, resolving types, and listing operators used in mobile modules.

classes.name: mobile::Module
classes.description: Represents a serialized mobile module in PyTorch JIT.

methods.name: _load_for_mobile
methods.description: Loads a serialized mobile module from various sources such as stream, filename, or ReadAdapterInterface, with optional device and load options.

methods.name: _load_extra_only_for_mobile
methods.description: Loads only the extra files from a mobile model archive without loading the entire model.

methods.name: resolveTypeNameMobile
methods.description: Resolves a type name to a type pointer within the mobile context.

methods.name: typeResolverMobile
methods.description: Resolves a qualified name to a strong type pointer in mobile.

methods.name: objLoaderMobile
methods.description: Loads an object of a specified type from an IValue in mobile.

methods.name: isTensorInBytecodeArchive
methods.description: Checks if tensors exist in the bytecode archive of a model stream.

methods.name: _export_operator_list
methods.description: Returns a set of operator names used by a given mobile module.
